visual_enhancers.red_ticket_cta: Red rectangle with notch/cutout circles on left and right borders simulating a vintage movie or event admission ticket
visual_enhancers.parchment_cards: Light cream bg #eadeca, subtle inner shadow, fine antique border #c2b280, optional wax seal or ink stamp badge overlay
visual_enhancers.checkerboard_border: Black and cream alternating square pattern strip separating sections
visual_enhancers.polaroid_cards: White borders with bottom caption space, slight rotation (-3deg to 3deg), drop shadow, hover lift transition

instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Ensure JS / JSX files in React are used (not TSX unless specified).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_rule: Every interactive element (button, link, input, tab, card, menu item) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case e.g. data-testid='booking-submit-btn', data-testid='nav-about-link', data-testid='hero-ticket-cta'.
instructions_to_main_agent.smooth_scroll: Clicking any 'Забронировать' or nav link must smoothly scroll to the respective section id (e.g., document.getElementById('contacts')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })).
instructions_to_main_agent.component_reuse: Use lucide-react icons for navigation, phone, map pin, clock, sparkles, checkmarks.
instructions_to_main_agent.toasts: Integrate sonner toast upon submitting the booking inquiry form.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use generic text-align: center on the main container.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or full transparent background on header/dropdowns.
Use generous padding (py-20 to py-28) to let the wonderland theme breathe.
Ensure high contrast on dark and parchment sections.
Add micro-interactions and hover states to all buttons, tickets, and polaroid cards.
